name: RedReplier
tagline: Finds people talking about your product, ranked by buying intent
description: It sweeps four public forums - Hacker News, Reddit, Bluesky and X - for anyone naming your product, naming a rival, or otherwise sounding like they are close to buying something. Fresh hits arrive already sorted, so the conversations most likely to become a customer sit at the top.
author: tarasshyn
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
